MINING ROYALTY ACT 2026 (SYNTHETIC TEST SAMPLE, NOT AN OFFICIAL TEXT)
As amended by the Mining Royalty Amendment Act 2027.
An Act to provide for the payment of royalty on minerals recovered under a mining lease.
PART 1
PRELIMINARY
Section 1. Short title
This Act may be cited as the Mining Royalty Act 2026.
Section 2. Interpretation
In this Act, "mineral" means any substance occurring naturally in or on the earth that is recovered under a mining lease, and "Minister" means the Minister responsible for mining.
PART 2
ROYALTY
Section 3. Royalty payable
(1) A holder of a mining lease must pay royalty to the State at the rate of 7 per cent of the value of the mineral recovered.
(2) Royalty is payable quarterly within 30 days after the end of each quarter.
(3) Interest accrues on unpaid royalty at the prescribed rate.
Section 3A. Critical minerals
Royalty on lithium, cobalt and rare earth elements is payable at the rate of 4 per cent of the value of the mineral recovered.
Section 5. Commencement
This Act commences on 1 January 2026.
